name: Greenbone (OpenVAS)
description: Shows what a Greenbone / OpenVAS vulnerability scanner found on your devices: every finding with its severity, CVE numbers, score, the port and the advice of the scanner. Netlens matches each finding to a device by address, warns about new critical vulnerabilities and lists the devices at risk. Read-only: it only asks for results, it never starts a scan.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Talks to the device through Netlens' shared HTTP client (certificate and host name checks, timeouts, size limit and redirect rules are the same in every plugin). Needs Netlens 0.4.366 or newer. No change in what the plugin reads or writes.

Tells you when the Netlens user sees no scan tasks: a Greenbone user only sees the tasks that are shared with it, so add it under Observers in every task (see the README). Found when setting it up on a real installation.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.4.73 or newer (the Vulnerabilities page). gvmd must listen with TLS (see the README).
